report:
Reassessed the complete claim, the sole implementation association (sage_meta::todo in representation_spec.rs), and all three associated tests. Baseline verification independently compared every historical implementation_sources/test_sources entry with current file bytes: representation_spec.rs, binary_operators.rs, and sage-test-harness/src/lib.rs all match exactly. The historical rationale remains appropriate, but this report independently scopes its conclusions to the current assertions and explicit TODO.

The clone test directly requires diagnostic-free Block -> ResolvedCall, Clone static trait dispatch, one explicit shared Ref receiver, a typed resolved field, explicit Deref, and a local path. This is meaningful partial evidence that method syntax and receiver adjustment recipes are consumed and borrows/dereferences materialized. The comparison test exercises equal and less, requiring PartialEq::eq and PartialOrd::lt resolved static calls returning bool and two explicit, typed shared references. Captured fixture and helper context confirms the u32 comparison inputs, symbol-name equality, function selection, and callback invocation (twice for the comparison harness). These assertions would detect source method/call shapes or omitted reference adjustments in those examples. They do not establish every coercion, every adjustment recipe, or whole-tree absence of unresolved/source-shaped operations.

The only implementation association and types_body_elaborated test explicitly defer completion because unsupported source-shaped TyExprData variants remain. The empty TODO test supplies no behavioral evidence. Its prerequisite is completion of elaboration for remaining constructs and whole-tree success/rejection fixtures, including explicit coercions and rejection of unresolved placeholders. The structured-control-flow qualification requires retaining a tree without basic blocks, drop schedules, generator lowering, or borrow-check results; the Block-shaped examples are compatible but do not prove that universal representation boundary. Full elaboration/whole-tree validation remains deferred under the existing TODO, with that high-level boundary preserved; this review does not demand the excluded lowerings. All claim aspects are accounted for as limited examples or explicitly deferred implementation/verification. No new inconsistency or suspected defect was found beyond that declared gap, so no edits are requested and TODO remains visible.

Method: source inspection, exact historical byte comparisons, review start/read, and this review record only; no behavioral tests or workspace build executed by this reviewer. The coordinator separately reports 321 sage-meta tests and cargo build passing, which is baseline execution evidence rather than proof of this deferred guarantee. A failed out-of-bounds helper read was corrected with a valid captured range; it was not a behavioral failure. All additional source context used for the assessment is captured in review reads.
